stages.name: Public-Facing Application Exploitation
observables: vulnerable software products detected on exposed services
anomalous HTTP requests to web servers

stages.name: Identity and SaaS Privilege Escalation
observables: anomalous authentication failure followed by success

stages.name: Cloud Resource Manipulation
observables: cloud administrator provisioning resources outside normal activity
new cloud instances or volumes appearing in inventory

stages.name: Anomalous Network Lateral Movement
observables: new network connections between systems that rarely communicate
outbound network activity from recently provisioned cloud resources

stages.name: Exfiltration over C2
observables: data transfer over existing command and control channels

scenario.summary: Adversaries exploit public-facing applications to gain a foothold before pivoting across cloud, SaaS, and endpoint environments. They frequently reconfigure cloud infrastructure and abuse identity permissions to stage and exfiltrate data through established command-and-control channels.

meta.rationale: Prioritize newly provisioned cloud instances and workstations in high-privilege network zones.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is moving laterally between internal hosts that do not typically interact and is exfiltrating data via high-volume network flows or anomalous DNS patterns.

blind_spots.risk: An adversary can move through unmanaged systems that do not report to EDR, breaking the visibility chain.
blind_spots.question: Are unmanaged assets acting as pivot points?
blind_spots.remediation: Enable VPC Flow Logs across all production accounts.

blind_spots.risk: While we see volume, we cannot see the data if it uses TLS to legitimate cloud storage providers.
blind_spots.question: What content is being exfiltrated over standard HTTPS?
blind_spots.requires: Decrypted network traffic or TLS inspection logs
blind_spots.remediation: Implement TLS decryption at the perimeter for high-risk categories.

hunt.name: Cross-Environment Lateral Movement and Exfiltration
hunt.description: This hunt targets the 'east-west' and 'north-south' movement that follows a cross-environment pivot. It identifies newly provisioned endpoints that engage in rare internal communication and correlates this with signs of data staging and exfiltration via anomalous DNS query patterns or high-volume outbound network transfers.

config.scoping_notes: Prioritize newly provisioned cloud instances and workstations in high-privilege network zones.
config.beyond_detection: A simple detection rule on high data volume produces noise. This hunt requires weighing the intersection of a new device profile, a rare internal destination, and exfiltration patterns simultaneously.

config.content: SELECT hostname, ip_address, device_uid, first_seen, os_name FROM hb_devices WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND first_seen >= datetime('now', '-{{scoping_days}} days') AND activity_id = 2
config.description: Identify hosts that have appeared in the estate recently, representing newly provisioned resources used for a cross-environment pivot.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts and their primary IPs. Silence means no new devices were enrolled in the scoping window.

primitive_config.label: Recently first-seen devices
primitive_config.content: SELECT hostname, ip_address, device_uid, first_seen, os_name FROM hb_devices WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND first_seen >= datetime('now', '-{{scoping_days}} days') AND activity_id = 2
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts and their primary IPs. Silence means no new devices were enrolled in the scoping window.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, process_name, COUNT(*) as conn_count FROM hb_network_connection WHERE state_kind = 'log' AND (instr(dst_endpoint_ip, '10.') = 1 OR instr(dst_endpoint_ip, '192.168.') = 1 OR instr(dst_endpoint_ip, '172.16.') = 1) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, process_name HAVING conn_count < 10 ORDER BY conn_count ASC
config.description: Detect lateral movement by finding host-to-host internal connections that are rare across the fleet, potentially indicating a pivot from a new asset.
config.expected_signal: Internal traffic between hosts that do not typically communicate. Silence suggests no unusual east-west movement from the scoped hosts.

primitive_config.label: Rare internal network pairs
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, process_name, COUNT(*) as conn_count FROM hb_network_connection WHERE state_kind = 'log' AND (instr(dst_endpoint_ip, '10.') = 1 OR instr(dst_endpoint_ip, '192.168.') = 1 OR instr(dst_endpoint_ip, '172.16.') = 1) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, process_name HAVING conn_count < 10 ORDER BY conn_count ASC
primitive_config.expected: Internal traffic between hosts that do not typically communicate. Silence suggests no unusual east-west movement from the scoped hosts.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) as query_count, MAX(length(query_hostname)) as max_len FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname HAVING max_len > 60 OR query_count > 200 ORDER BY query_count DESC
config.description: Detect DNS-based exfiltration or C2 beaconing from the scoped assets.
config.expected_signal: Long query hostnames containing potential encoded data or high-frequency lookups to rare domains.

primitive_config.label: High-entropy or anomalous DNS lookups
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) as query_count, MAX(length(query_hostname)) as max_len FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname HAVING max_len > 60 OR query_count > 200 ORDER BY query_count DESC
primitive_config.expected: Long query hostnames containing potential encoded data or high-frequency lookups to rare domains.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_ip, SUM(traffic_bytes) as total_bytes FROM hb_network_connection WHERE state_kind = 'log' AND direction = 'outbound' AND NOT (instr(dst_endpoint_ip, '10.') = 1 OR instr(dst_endpoint_ip, '192.168.') = 1 OR instr(dst_endpoint_ip, '172.16.') = 1) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_ip HAVING total_bytes > 104857600 ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
config.description: Identify potential volumetric exfiltration to external IP addresses from the scoped assets.
config.expected_signal: Large transfers (>100MB) from scoped hosts to external destinations. Silence suggests exfiltration is not occurring through high-volume direct flows.

primitive_config.label: High-volume outbound data flows
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_ip, SUM(traffic_bytes) as total_bytes FROM hb_network_connection WHERE state_kind = 'log' AND direction = 'outbound' AND NOT (instr(dst_endpoint_ip, '10.') = 1 OR instr(dst_endpoint_ip, '192.168.') = 1 OR instr(dst_endpoint_ip, '172.16.') = 1) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_ip HAVING total_bytes > 104857600 ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
primitive_config.expected: Large transfers (>100MB) from scoped hosts to external destinations. Silence suggests exfiltration is not occurring through high-volume direct flows.

config.objective: Determine if any host exhibits both anomalous internal connectivity (lateral movement) and signs of data theft (DNS exfiltration or volumetric flows).
config.description: Correlate scoping results, rare internal connections, and exfiltration signals per host to determine if a full attack path is visible.
config.expected_signal: A per-host verdict linking lateral movement with exfiltration.
config.success_criteria: A risk verdict (malicious|suspicious|benign) for each host, with a timeline of events.
